mcqs.question: According to the Supreme Court bench of Justice B. V. Nagarathna and Justice Ujjal Bhuyan, Article 32 can be invoked only for which purpose?
options: Violation of any ordinary legal right
mcqs.explanation: The Supreme Court bench held that Article 32 is meant only for violations of fundamental rights. The tempting broader option is incorrect because the Court specifically limited Article 32 to fundamental-rights violations.
